title: Plans for Fauna and Flora of Jurong Bird Park after 3 January 2023 Closure
what_it_is: Plans for Fauna and Flora of Jurong Bird Park after 3 January 2023 Closure

sections.label: Bird Park relocation to Mandai
sections.summary: Mandai Wildlife Group will move over 3,000 birds and about 50 flora species from Jurong Bird Park to Bird Paradise after its 3 January 2023 closure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Speaker, Mandai Wildlife Group will move more than 3,000 birds and about 50 species of flora from Jurong Bird Park to Bird Paradise at Mandai after it closes on 3 January 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Mandai Wildlife Group's detailed planning for this move includes necessary steps and measures to ensure the welfare, health and safety of the birds during the relocation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Jurong Bird Park site is expected to be returned to JTC in 2025.

sections.label: Jurong Hill future plans review
sections.summary: JTC, URA and NParks are jointly reviewing longer-term land use plans for the Jurong Bird Park site, with public feedback sought for Jurong Hill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: And two, will there be a cross-Ministry workgroup that coordinates and determines this balanced approach of redeveloping large green spaces?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I do not have the economic value of the site; I can get back to the Member.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But JTC and URA are jointly reviewing the longer-term land use plans for the site, along with other agencies like NParks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We will take into consideration existing features, such as the waterfall as well as the Jurong Hill Tower nearby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Given the memories and history tied to Jurong Bird Park, we will seek public feedback in due time to shape the future plans for Jurong Hill together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Meanwhile, I encourage everyone to visit Jurong Bird Park before it closes on 3 January 2023 and also to support Bird Paradise when it opens in the second quarter of 2023.
